resources.string: Your numbers are read from Health Connect on this phone. The app doesn\'t use a server and never uploads your health data. Signing in is optional and doesn\'t download your stats.
Today covers midnight until now in this phone\'s time zone. Sleep counts from 6 PM yesterday, so last night is included. Home reads again when you open it and when you pull down from the top.
The app asks to read steps, distance, calories, workouts, heart rate, floors, elevation and sleep. Only the types you allow are read, and a stat your phone didn\'t record stays off your story.
The step total Health Connect adds up for today, and how far that is toward your daily step goal.
The distance total from Health Connect, shown in kilometers or miles depending on your setting.

Today\'s workouts, with the distance, calories, heart rate, elevation and steps recorded during each one. Today\'s story lists them all. Health Connect asks before sharing a GPS route, one workout at a time.
Posting opens Instagram\'s own story composer with your design or a stats sticker. Nothing is posted until you tap share in Instagram.
